snippet.title: Powerplay - Early Access Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Today is the day! Powerplay comes out today July 29th at 10am PT, on Steam Early Access. 
It's been a very long journey, and we're grateful to everyone who tested, shared feedback, and helped shape it along the way.
I hope you enjoy playing it and we can't wait to see where we take it!

👉 Play the game: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3010280/Powerplay/

#RTS #StrategyGames #IndieGame #GameDev
